title: Основные показатели исполнения заказа
sql:
SELECT json_build_object(
  'orders',          (SELECT count(*) FROM core.orders WHERE purchased_at < '2018-09-01'),
  'delivered',       (SELECT count(*) FROM d),
  'otd',             (SELECT round(avg(on_time::int), 4) FROM d),
  'otd_naive',       (SELECT round(avg((delivered_at <= estimated_delivery_date)::int), 4) FROM d),
  'on_promise_day',  (SELECT count(*) FROM d WHERE delivered_at::date = estimated_delivery_date),
  'median_days',     (SELECT round(percentile_cont(.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_total)::numeric, 1) FROM d),
  'p90_days',        (SELECT round(percentile_cont(.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_total)::numeric, 1) FROM d),
  'median_promised', (SELECT round(percentile_cont(.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY estimated_delivery_date - purchased_at::date)::numeric, 1) FROM d),
  'median_approve',  (SELECT round(percentile_cont(.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM approved_at - purchased_at) / 86400)::numeric, 2) FROM d),
  'median_seller',   (SELECT round(percentile_cont(.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_seller)::numeric, 1) FROM d),
  'median_carrier',  (SELECT round(percentile_cont(.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_carrier)::numeric, 1) FROM d),
  'cancel_rate',     (SELECT round(avg((status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable'))::int), 4) FROM core.orders WHERE purchased_at < '2018-09-01'),
  'stuck',           (SELECT count(*) FROM core.orders WHERE status = 'shipped'
                        AND estimated_delivery_date < (SELECT max(purchased_at)::date FROM core.orders)),
  'avg_score',       (SELECT round(avg(score), 2) FROM d JOIN lr USING (order_id)),
  'seller_on_time',  (SELECT round(avg((shipped_at <= lim)::int), 4) FROM os),
  'seller_pairs',    (SELECT count(*) FROM os),
  'sellers_100plus', (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT seller_id FROM os GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) >= 100) z)
)

dashboard_base.d:
SELECT o.*,
       (o.delivered_at::date <= o.estimated_delivery_date) AS on_time,
       extract(epoch FROM o.delivered_at - o.purchased_at) / 86400 AS days_total,
       CASE WHEN o.shipped_at >= o.approved_at
            THEN extract(epoch FROM o.shipped_at - o.approved_at) / 86400 END AS days_seller,
       CASE WHEN o.delivered_at >= o.shipped_at
            THEN extract(epoch FROM o.delivered_at - o.shipped_at) / 86400 END AS days_carrier
FROM core.orders o
WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
  AND o.delivered_at IS NOT NULL
  AND o.purchased_at < '2018-09-01'
dashboard_base.lr:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (order_id) order_id, score
FROM core.order_reviews
ORDER BY order_id, created_at DESC, answered_at DESC NULLS LAST
dashboard_base.os:
SELECT i.order_id, i.seller_id, max(i.shipping_limit_at) AS lim, o.shipped_at
FROM core.order_items i
JOIN core.orders o USING (order_id)
WHERE o.shipped_at IS NOT NULL
  AND o.purchased_at < '2018-09-01'
  AND i.order_id IN (SELECT order_id FROM core.order_items
                     GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT seller_id) = 1)
GROUP BY i.order_id, i.seller_id, o.shipped_at

units: Доли: 0–1; сроки: дни; оценки: 1–5; количества: шт.

definitions.delivered: Доставленные с датой вручения, оформление до 2018-09-01.
definitions.otd: Доля доставленных вовремя: delivered_at::date <= estimated_delivery_date; NULL исключаются из среднего.
definitions.otd_naive: Диагностическое сравнение timestamp с обещанной датой в полночь, занижает своевременность.
definitions.median_days: Медиана дней от оформления до вручения.
definitions.p90_days: 90-й перцентиль дней от оформления до вручения.
definitions.median_promised: Медиана обещанного срока в календарных днях.
definitions.median_approve: Медиана дней от оформления до подтверждения.
definitions.median_seller: Медиана дней от подтверждения до передачи в доставку; отрицательные этапы исключены.
definitions.median_carrier: Медиана дней от передачи в доставку до вручения; отрицательные этапы исключены.
definitions.cancel_rate: Доля canceled + unavailable среди всех заказов до 2018-09-01.
definitions.stuck: shipped с обещанной датой до максимальной даты оформления в выбранном срезе; исторический снимок.
definitions.avg_score: Средняя последняя оценка: created_at DESC, answered_at DESC NULLS LAST (правило текущего дашборда).
definitions.seller_on_time: Доля своевременных отгрузок: shipped_at <= max(shipping_limit_at); только однопродавцовые заказы.
definitions.seller_pairs: Число пар заказ-продавец в однопродавцовых заказах с известной отгрузкой.
definitions.sellers_100plus: Продавцы с не менее 100 однопродавцовыми отгрузками.

limitations: Исторический снимок Olist, не текущие заказы.
Для фильтра по категории/продавцу выбираются целые заказы, содержащие эти позиции.
Последний отзыв дашборда: created_at DESC, answered_at DESC NULLS LAST; в разборе отзывов первым идёт answered_at.
Только однопродавцовые заказы используются для своевременности отгрузки.

title: Проверки качества данных
sql:
SELECT json_build_object(
  'orders_with_items',       (SELECT count(DISTINCT order_id) FROM core.order_items),
  'orders_without_items',    (SELECT count(*) FROM core.orders o
                                WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM core.order_items i WHERE i.order_id = o.order_id)),
  'multi_seller_orders',     (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT order_id FROM core.order_items
                                GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT seller_id) > 1) x),
  'order_seller_pairs',      (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT order_id, seller_id FROM core.order_items) x),
  'multi_review_orders',     (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT order_id FROM core.order_reviews
                                GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) > 1) x),
  'diff_score_orders',       (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT order_id FROM core.order_reviews
                                GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT score) > 1) x),
  'no_review_orders',        (SELECT count(*) FROM core.orders o
                                WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM core.order_reviews r WHERE r.order_id = o.order_id)),
  'shipped_before_approved', (SELECT count(*) FROM core.orders WHERE shipped_at < approved_at),
  'shipped_before_purchase', (SELECT count(*) FROM core.orders WHERE shipped_at < purchased_at),
  'delivered_no_date',       (SELECT count(*) FROM core.orders WHERE status = 'delivered' AND delivered_at IS NULL),
  'tail_orders',             (SELECT count(*) FROM core.orders WHERE purchased_at >= '2018-09-01'),
  'tail_canceled',           (SELECT count(*) FROM core.orders WHERE purchased_at >= '2018-09-01' AND status = 'canceled'),
  'review_before_delivery',  (SELECT count(*) FROM core.order_reviews r JOIN core.orders o USING (order_id)
                                WHERE o.delivered_at IS NOT NULL AND r.created_at < o.delivered_at::date)
)

title: Оценки по величине просрочки
sql:
SELECT json_agg(t ORDER BY ord) FROM (
  SELECT ord,
         (ARRAY['Вовремя', '1–3 дня', '4–7 дней', '8–14 дней', '15+ дней'])[ord] AS bucket,
         count(*) AS reviews,
         round(avg(score), 2) AS avg_score,
         round(avg((score <= 2)::int), 4) AS neg_share
  FROM (SELECT lr.score,
               CASE WHEN delivered_at::date - estimated_delivery_date <= 0  THEN 1
                    WHEN delivered_at::date - estimated_delivery_date <= 3  THEN 2
                    WHEN delivered_at::date - estimated_delivery_date <= 7  THEN 3
                    WHEN delivered_at::date - estimated_delivery_date <= 14 THEN 4
                    ELSE 5 END AS ord
        FROM d JOIN lr USING (order_id)) x
  GROUP BY ord) t

title: Продавцы с худшей своевременностью отгрузки
sql:
SELECT json_agg(t ORDER BY on_time, shipments DESC) FROM (
  SELECT left(os.seller_id, 8) AS seller, s.state,
         count(*) AS shipments,
         round(avg((shipped_at <= lim)::int), 4) AS on_time
  FROM os JOIN core.sellers s USING (seller_id)
  GROUP BY os.seller_id, s.state
  HAVING count(*) >= 100
  ORDER BY avg((shipped_at <= lim)::int), count(*) DESC
  LIMIT 15) t

title: Выручка и число заказов по месяцам
sql:
WITH months AS (
    SELECT generate_series('2016-09-01'::date, '2018-08-01', interval '1 month')::date AS month
),
monthly AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc('month', o.purchased_at)::date AS month,
        count(DISTINCT o.order_id)                AS orders_cnt,
        coalesce(sum(i.price) FILTER (WHERE o.status = 'delivered'), 0) AS revenue
    FROM core.orders o
    LEFT JOIN core.order_items i USING (order_id)
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    m.month,
    coalesce(t.orders_cnt, 0) AS orders_cnt,
    coalesce(t.revenue, 0)    AS revenue
FROM months m
LEFT JOIN monthly t USING (month)
ORDER BY m.month
units: Выручка/чек: BRL; доли: проценты 0–100; количества: шт.

definitions.avg_check: Среднее sum(price + freight_value) по доставленному заказу
definitions.customers: customer_unique_id; повторные покупки учитывают все статусы

limitations: При фильтрах категории/продавца чек относится к целому заказу; выручка — к выбранным позициям.

title: Топ-10 продавцов по выручке
sql:
SELECT
    s.seller_id,
    s.city,
    s.state,
    count(DISTINCT i.order_id) AS orders_cnt,
    count(*)                   AS units,
    sum(i.price)               AS revenue
FROM core.order_items i
JOIN core.orders  o USING (order_id)
JOIN core.sellers s USING (seller_id)
WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY s.seller_id, s.city, s.state
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 10

title: Средний чек доставленного заказа
sql:
WITH per_order AS (
    SELECT
        i.order_id,
        sum(i.price + i.freight_value) AS order_total,
        count(*)                       AS lines,
        count(*)                       AS units   
    FROM core.order_items i
    JOIN core.orders o USING (order_id)
    WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY i.order_id
)
SELECT
    round(avg(order_total), 2) AS avg_check,
    round(avg(lines), 2)       AS avg_lines_per_order,
    round(avg(units), 2)       AS avg_units_per_order
FROM per_order
units: Выручка/чек: BRL; доли: проценты 0–100; количества: шт.

title: Покупатели и повторные покупки
sql:
WITH per_customer AS (
    SELECT customer_unique_id, count(*) AS orders_cnt
    FROM core.orders
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    count(*)                                   AS customers_total,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE orders_cnt >= 2)    AS returned,
    round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE orders_cnt >= 2) / count(*), 2) AS returned_pct
FROM per_customer

title: Выручка по категориям
sql:
SELECT
    coalesce(p.category_name, '(без категории)') AS category,
    sum(i.price)                                 AS revenue,
    round(100 * sum(i.price) / sum(sum(i.price)) OVER (), 2) AS revenue_pct
FROM core.order_items i
JOIN core.orders   o USING (order_id)
JOIN core.products p USING (product_id)
WHERE o.status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY revenue DESC
units: Выручка/чек: BRL; доли: проценты 0–100; количества: шт.

definitions.avg_check: Среднее sum(price + freight_value) по доставленному заказу
definitions.customers: customer_unique_id; повторные покупки учитывают все статусы

limitations: При фильтрах категории/продавца чек относится к целому заказу; выручка — к выбранным позициям.
